content_sections.heading: NGEL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 147 vacancies notified under Advt. No. 04/26 are spread across eight posts, as shown below. The vacancy numbers include category-wise reservation and any backlog, as per the prescribed roster points. The notification clarifies that the projected vacancy numbers may increase or decrease at NGEL management's discretion. Out of the total vacancies, 14 posts are reserved for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates - 7 in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/Safety and 7 in HR/Finance/CSR/Rajbhasha - and these PwBD vacancies are inclusive of backlog. Abbreviations used in the notification: B=Blind, LV=Low Vision, D=Deaf, HH=Hard of Hearing, OA=One Arm, OL=One Leg, BA=Both Arms, BL=Both Leg, OAL=One Arm and One Leg, BLOA=Both Leg & One Arm, BLA=Both Legs Arms, CP=Cerebral Palsy, LC=Leprosy Cured, Dw=Dwarfism, AAV=Acid Attack Victims, Mdy=Muscular Dystrophy, ASD=Autism Spectrum Disorder (M=Mild, MoD=Moderate), ID=Intellectual Disability, SLD=Specific Learning Disability, MI=Mental Illness, MD=Multiple Disabilities.

content_sections.heading: NGEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: NGEL may conduct a multi-stage selection process comprising application shortlisting/screening, a Computer-Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion and/or Interview, or a combination of these, and reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards if required. The CBT is bilingual with multiple-choice questions and has two sections: Section 1 – Subject Knowledge Test (SKT) (discipline-specific questions) and Section 2 – Aptitude Test (AT) (numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation). The test has 100 questions and a duration of 2 hours . There is negative marking : ¼ of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for every wrong answer. Online CBT centres: Kolkata, Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Vishakhapatnam, Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, Bhopal and Raipur. Shortlisted candidates from the CBT are called for an interview. Shortlisting will instead be done on the basis of age, qualification and experience, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview directly. Additional notes on experience marking: 5 marks are awarded for meeting the minimum required experience, plus 1 additional mark for every extra year of experience, up to a maximum of 10 marks. The final offer of appointment is issued based on the candidate's relative rank in the merit list prepared from the cumulative total marks. Joining is subject to the candidate passing a medical examination at a specified government hospital and being declared medically fit.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NGEL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents while applying online: Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/marksheet and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB must match across all documents). Engineering consolidated marksheet/transcript/all-semester marksheets showing aggregate percentage of marks, or the CA/CMA (ICWA) passing certificate, or Master's degree certificate with marksheets, as applicable. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI into a percentage. Documents related to the essential qualification (pass certificate and marksheets, mode, duration, specialisation). Documents related to any other qualification (pass certificate and marksheets). Caste/Disability certificate, for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates, as applicable. OBC-NCL certificate in the central format for financial year 2026-27. EWS candidates: current-year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27, based on FY 2025-26 income. Disability certificates as per the latest Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability for the post. Documents supporting the requisite years of post-qualification executive experience - in chronological order from the most recent organisation backward - including experience certificate, appointment/offer/joining letter, confirmation letter or training-completion order (if any), promotion order, role-assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and two payslips per year. Self-attested copies of age proof, marksheets/transcripts and certificates for all qualifications, and experience certificates from all organisations specifically mentioning area of specialisation/job performed/expertise. Candidates from Government organisations/PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to provide it within a stipulated time / obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026 - NGEL Apply Online
content_sections.text: Visit the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in . No other mode of application is accepted. Register with a valid, active email ID, since NGEL will not be responsible for any bounced-back emails. Fill in the online application form and upload all required documents listed above. Pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 500 (General/EWS/OBC candidates) online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card or UPI. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and female candidates are exempt from the fee. Submit the application and download the system-generated application slip carrying a unique registration number. Retain a copy of the application slip for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NGEL Recruitment 2026 refers to Advertisement No. 04/26 issued by NTPC Green Energy Limited to fill 147 Engineer and Executive vacancies in the Renewable Energy segment, on a fixed-term basis of 3 years (extendable up to 2 more years).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 147 vacancies are notified across eight posts: Engineer (RE-Civil) - 43, Engineer (RE-Electrical) - 69, Engineer (RE-Mechanical) - 9, Executive (RE-HR) - 4, Executive (RE-Finance) - 9, Engineer (RE-Safety) - 7, Executive (RE-CSR) - 5, and Executive (RE-Rajbhasha) - 1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 7 September 2026 at 18:00 Hrs. Applications opened on 18 August 2026 at 10:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post - engineering degrees (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Safety-related), HR/management postgraduate degrees, CA/CMA for Finance, a relevant postgraduate degree/MSW/MBA/Engineering degree for CSR, and a Hindi/English Master's degree for Rajbhasha. Full post-wise qualification details are given in the eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for all eight posts, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10 years for PwBD, and as per government norms for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500 (non-refundable) for General/EWS/OBC candidates. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and female candidates do not need to pay the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in. No other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection may involve application screening, a Computer-Based Test (Subject Knowledge Test + Aptitude Test), Group Discussion, and/or Interview, followed by an experience-and-interview-based evaluation, as detailed in the selection process section above.
